verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible reading order (logo, then headline, copy, CTA), but the logo is oversized and outranks the headline. The badge is squashed into a flattened oval and jammed beside the CTA, and the sunglasses are tucked awkwardly at the top edge of the panel. B breaks the reading order: the CTA and badge sit at the very top as tiny items, crammed with oversized sunglasses that run off the panel edge. The panel bleeds off the canvas edge, and there is a large dead gap between the logo and the headline.
